verdict.rationale: Companies House runs a public REST API, so asking whether it offers a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is a fair question. The evidence covers a developer-specs site with guides on authorisation, rate limiting and versioning, plus a live API that returns structured auth errors. None of it shows a downloadable machine-readable spec (OpenAPI, Swagger or equivalent), and the probe found no agent-oriented docs index such as llms.txt.
